title: Minecraft BEST Creeper Farm 1.21 - Java & Bedrock - 15000+ Gunpowder Per Hour!
description:
Hello Guys TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Tutorial I Will Show you how to make The new version of the last creeper farm but in this version portal based with improvements [ Quad ] in Minecraft 1.21

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰🥰
Don't Forget Like & Comment And Subscribe🙏🥰💗💖
With Subscribing You Will Supporting me And Give Me More Energy 😍

📚This farm is extremely fast and can produce +9000 ~ +15000 Gunpowder Per Hour ! 
📚This farm is so efficient and I highly recommend this farm, it takes about 1 - 3 hours to build.
📚Important : Best Difficulty [ Hard ] - Render Distance [ 6 - 8 ] - Simulation Distance [ 6 - 7 ] - Best Location for this farm [ High heights locations, Deep Ocean Biomes[All-Types], Spawn-Proofed areas and Perimeter - Best Mode ( With Sword - On Both Platforms ) ]
📚You can use looting enchantment to get higher rates from this farm.
📚If you want to build this farm on the land be sure to start the building at y = 240 and if you want to build this farm on top of the ocean you can start the building from y = 140.
📚In this design, you can add more layers but it's not efficient 2 layers are the recommended number of layers.
